checks: Combined preparation and source-access cost is visible before installation; one click opens its handoff, and a remounted control recovers the same ID without another charge.
Changed selections clear the old quote immediately; late earlier responses cannot install the wrong apps or attach their fee.
Failed quotes and cost refreshes only perform reads; stale fees disable dispatch, and the fresh visible fee retains the original request ID.
Changing the displayed stable/beta release clears its old quote identity while retaining the same app IDs.
A changed preference disables stale installation and lets Prepare latest review a new request without charging.
A submitted request awaiting reconciliation remains explicitly distinguishable from a new installation after preferences change.
Owned app details share the cost-aware one-click Install control at narrow and wide tile sizes; public Get retains acquisition behavior.
Normal agent installation review displays exact apps, principals and cost; declining causes no installation, and inconsistent fee summaries are rejected.
Rejected installation errors stay visible in the detail dialog; duplicate clicks dispatch once, and only explicit cost refresh plus another Install prepares the original ID.
